final: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_patient), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - overall.mean_share) FROM shares CROSS JOIN overall WHERE share > overall.mean_share
